clusters.name: root
clusters.desc: Core biological logic layer: DNA utilities, sequence I/O, annotation model, primer design, assembly validation, and all enzyme databases — the app's domain engine.

clusters.name: store
clusters.desc: Monolithic Zustand+Immer store composed of 7 flat slices: projects, library entries, canvas nav, workspace router, primers, UI preferences, annotator, and common-features overlay.

clusters.name: components/AppShell
clusters.desc: Thin content-area frame + workspace router that switches between Library, DAG, and Importer via store.workspace.active.

clusters.name: components/StartScreen
clusters.desc: App home/dashboard screen: project list, sidebar nav, file drop zone, and help popover — mounted by App.jsx as the 'start' fullscreen surface.

clusters.name: components/Dag
clusters.desc: Fullscreen project-level DAG view: library palette + drag-to-canvas + ReactFlow node graph of plasmid containers with auto-layout.

clusters.name: components/CanvasSkeleton
clusters.desc: Self-contained four-tier assembly workbench (canvas + editor + operations + zones) with isolated useReducer state, persisted per-project to IndexedDB.

clusters.name: components/Toast
clusters.desc: Fixed-position notification stack rendering ephemeral success/error/warning/info toasts with optional undo action and auto-dismiss.

clusters.name: lib
clusters.desc: Cross-cutting service layer: I/O serialization (.bodge ZIP v1/v2), persistence (IndexedDB/localStorage), annotation editing, sequence search, UI strings, hotkeys, DAG layout, and bio algorithms.

clusters.name: components/Library
clusters.desc: Full-screen Library workspace: file/paste import pipeline, entry browser with project/loose/trash tree, and multi-tab sequence inspector.

clusters.name: canvas
clusters.desc: Lab notebook UI (split-edit + markdown preview) and project export modal — ready-to-mount but not yet wired into the main app.

clusters.name: hooks
clusters.desc: App-level React hooks extracting side-effects, fragment mutation logic, sequence selection state, and markdown ref resolution from App.jsx.

clusters.name: components/Annotator
clusters.desc: Fullscreen/embedded multi-level annotation orchestrator: runs plugin pipeline, surfaces ghost predictions, and lets the user accept/reject/edit them before committing to a fragment.

clusters.name: components/SequenceView
clusters.desc: Interactive linear DNA sequence viewer: per-line tracks (primer/RE/ruler/strands/annotation/AA), overlays, and edit operations.

clusters.name: db
clusters.desc: Single-file Dexie/IndexedDB persistence layer: schema versioning (v1-v6) + CRUD helpers for all 6 tables.
